thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING ONCALL: GPU pool saturation detected in us-west-2 (cluster=prod-inference). queue_depth=1240, oldest_request=00:12:37. Autoscaler errors seen.

maria: ack oncall — I'm on my way. posting brief.

samir: seeing 503s from the inference gateway and steady queue growth. customers hitting tail latency >10s.

alex: oncall-bot logs show repeated scale-up failures. paste of recent autoscaler stderr:

```
I0415 12:34:56 cluster-autoscaler.go:400] ScaleUp: best option nodeGroup=gpu-pool-3 (min=0, max=40, desired=40) size=40
E0415 12:34:57 aws_manager.go:221] AttachInstanceProfile failed: AccessDenied: iam:PassRole
status code: 403, request id: 1234abcd
I0415 12:35:02 cluster-autoscaler.go:512] Unable to scale up: error attaching instance profile to launched instance: AccessDenied
```

jin: hmm, PassRole 403 — that's odd, we rolled a launchtemplate update last night that tightened instance profile permissions.

ops-bot: Automated mitigation suggestion: temporarily increase fallback nodes (cpu-only) and divert low-priority inference jobs. Approve? :warning:

maria: approve. we need immediate throughput relief. Samir/Leo please kick manual CPU nodeadd; we'll handle GPU auth in parallel.

samir: kicking manual ASG increase for cpu-pool (non-gpu) by +8 to absorb async batch work. command run: `aws autoscaling set-desired-capacity --auto-scaling-group-name cpu-pool-asg --desired-capacity 24`

alex: started routing batch inference to cpu-pool via routing rule rollout (canary=10%). hope this reduces queue appetite on GPU path.

jin: investigating the 403. verifying IAM policy bound to the cluster autoscaler role. looks like a condition was added restricting `iam:PassRole` to `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/rt-*` patterns; our GPU attach uses `role/gpu-launch-role-v2`.

maria: who approved that policy change last night? need rollback if that's the root cause.

leo: that change came from infra/pr-789 (safe-hardening). I didn't realize autoscaler used different role. Patch was targeted at exec roles.

ops-bot: NOTE: customers impacted: 3 high-volume tenants show degraded p99 latency; overall request success rate at 95% across inference-api.

customer-bridge: messaging ready: "We’re experiencing degraded performance for some model inference requests in us-west-2. We have a mitigation in place and are working on a permanent fix. No data loss reported." Approve to send?

maria: approve, small update: ETA for perf normalization ~30-45m given node boot times. send now.

samir: cpu-pool nodes are healthy and picking up batch jobs; queue decreased from 1240 -> 720 in 6m. Good short-term.

alex: attempted manual launch of a GPU instance via ASG with `--override` but attach failed with same PassRole 403.

jin: I'm preparing a rollback to the IAM policy that added the restrictive condition. will run change with rollback tag and alert. Need a quick approval from infra lead.

maria: I'm pinging infra-lead (via DM) now. If they don't respond in 5m, proceed with safe rollback and notify.

ops-bot: Temporary routing tweak: increased cpu-only canary to 30% to further drain queue. Watch for model quality regression (we're using smaller replicas).

leo: infra-lead acknowledged and gave green to rollback. Jin, please proceed and post verification steps.

jin: rolling back IAM change. command: `terraform apply -target=aws_iam_policy.example -var='rollback=true'`

```
Apply complete! Resources: 0 added, 1 changed, 0 destroyed.
```

jin: after rollback, trigger a dummy attach to validate: `aws ec2 run-instances --launch-template LaunchTemplateId=lt-0abcde --iam-instance-profile Name=gpu-launch-role-v2` — instance launched and profile attached successfully.

samir: cluster-autoscaler logs now show progress:
```
I0415 12:48:50 cluster-autoscaler.go:620] Launching node in nodegroup gpu-pool-3
I0415 12:49:30 cluster-autoscaler.go:698] ScaleUp: waiting for nodes to join
```

alex: GPU nodes coming up — observed 3 join in last 8m. queue at 220 and dropping.

maria: good. keep autoscale under observation for another 30m. Jin, please open a postmortem-ticket and assign to infra + platform for policy gating review.

jin: created ticket INF-4321 (postmortem + remediation). I'll include timeline, terraform diff, and recommended guardrails: add automated integration test that simulates autoscaler instance attach after any IAM policy change.

customer-bridge: update sent to affected tenants. will follow up when metrics fully normalized.

ops-bot: Incident severity downgraded to SEV2 at 12:55 PDT — partial customer impact mitigated; full normalization target 13:20 PDT.

maria: thanks team. follow-up actions: 1) add CI check for PassRole coverage 2) document autoscaler roles and update runbooks 3) review launchtemplate naming conventions to avoid role mismatches.

samir: noted. I'll run a smoke test across regions to ensure no other clusters have the same restrictive policy.

alex: leaving the channel but will watch alerts. ping me if anything re-escalates. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident closed for oncall handoff. Final note: root cause = IAM policy change restricting iam:PassRole to a different name pattern, causing attach failures during GPU scaleup. Mitigation = rollback + CPU fallback routing + manual ASG adjustments.
